name: Gestation barn (pigs); tunnel ventilated; stalls with fully-slatted floors
description: The inventory takes into account the use of construction materials and building machines for construction, repair and replacement including waste disposal and the transportation of the materials to the building site. Not taken into account were direct emission of the construction, disposal of production waste and the use of resources during utilization phase.

processDocumentation.geographyDescription: Represents production at the national level.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: The module includes a pen for fattening pigs with fully-slatted floor, fittings, slurry store. Size 120 pig places. Lifetime of the building is 50 years.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: Requires upstream unit processes from DataSmart for the production of building materials, in addition to excavation and material transportation.  Inputs from other construction activities are not included.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: This is a cradle-to-gate process for the production of building materials
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Information on the mass of building materials used in the construction of a gestation barn was obtained from building plans and used as a basis for the life cycle inventory.  Lifetime of the building was assumed 50 years.
processDocumentation.samplingDescription: Flow values for construction materials were obtained from building plans.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data for this project were collected from 2007 to 2014. Unit process data were compiled in 2014.

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
processDocumentation.projectDescription: Data were prepared by the University of Arkansas Center for Agricultural and Rural Sustainability for the United States Department of Agriculture National Agriculture Library.  This project was supported in part by the National Pork Board.

publication.name: Development of Life Cycle Inventory data for U.S. Swine Production Scenarios

dataSetOwner.name: University of Arkansas Office for Sustainability
